if_protected_outcomes_already_observed: retention resolution fails; document contamination and reopen protocol
purpose: Resolve the non-unique corrected-eligibility universe without re-optimizing the production generator on consumed development evidence.
retention_rule: If the already-frozen production candidate remains corrected-eligible and no D3, reserve, primary, or external TEST outcomes have been observed, retain it as the primary benchmark specification. Do not rank or re-select among the expanded eligible universe.
secondary_robustness_scope: endpoint-preserving v2.2 family must be represented in a separately frozen robustness protocol before primary benchmark execution
status: prospectively specified before formal retention resolution
